name: Gabriela A. Bernal
office: City of Maywood, Member of the City Council

items.text: Gabriela A. Bernal says she has run a business in Maywood for years. She says she wants to enhance public safety and improve quality of life. She has criticized local leadership for a lack of visible change, and says streets feel less safe.
